results.name: Spider-Man (2014; The Amazing Spider-Man 2)
results.description:
Mainly retopo'd and used the AR phone model (which is the closest to the CG model) as a base for this. Tweaked some spots like the head and physique to match both Andrew Garfield and the physical suit. This includes a fbx with mixamo rigging and 4k/2k PBR textures. 

Feel absolutely free to edit, modify or port to any program or game as you please.

results.name: Portrait of a man
results.description:
Portrait of a Man, 27 BC-AD 14
Italy, Roman, Augustan period
bronze, Overall: 38.1 x 21.6 cm (15 x 8 1/2 in). Gift of the John Huntington Art and Polytechnic Trust 1928.860
Location:  103 Roman
A fine example of the realistic portraiture of the Late Republican Period. In scattered areas the surface has been cleaned down to the metal base.

[Stable URL](http://www.clevelandart.org/art/1928.860)
